title: VehicleTelemetry
description: One telemetry packet published by a simulated taxi on fleet/<vehicleID>/telemetry. Single source of truth for the payload shape: db/mongo/init-telemetry.sh applies it as the MongoDB $jsonSchema validator, and services/event-router loads it into Ajv. Uses only keywords both engines accept.

_id.description: allowed so the MongoDB validator accepts the auto-generated key under additionalProperties:false; never present on an inbound MQTT payload

seatWeightKg.description: optional - seat-weight sensor, the union of the plan's two sensor lists

timestamp.description: Unix epoch milliseconds, stamped at the simulated edge
